result.summary: Found 2 issues: a minor accessibility contrast problem and a minor content typo.

issues.description: Light gray placeholder text in the search bar ('Restarants, dishes, groceries') has insufficient contrast against its light background, making it difficult to read for users with low vision.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast ratio of the placeholder text to meet WCAG accessibility guidelines, ensuring it is clearly distinguishable from the search bar background.

issues.description: The placeholder text in the search bar contains a spelling typo: 'Restarants' should be 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling to 'Restaurants' in the search bar placeholder text.
